extracted.intended_audience: general readers of Stylist and those interested in survivor testimonies / high-profile sexual abuse cases
extracted.subtask_description: A web-magazine feature that curates and presents multiple first-person impact statements from survivors of sexual abuse, supplemented with legal context, statistics, and images. The piece emphasizes survivors' voices and the broader social and institutional implications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content warning / trigger notice
rubrics_metrics.description: Warning: this article contains details of a sexual assault case that some readers may find triggering.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Place a clear, prominent trigger/content warning at the top of the piece when it contains graphic or potentially retraumatising descriptions; this article uses a one-line warning before survivor testimonies begin.

rubrics_metrics.name: Center survivors' first-person statements
rubrics_metrics.description: Stylist shares 26 of the survivors’ stories, alongside powerful words they spoke aloud in court, using direct quotations addressed to the abuser and descriptions of their experiences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use direct first-person quotes and impact statements to foreground survivors' voices; include lines spoken to the accused, emotional reactions, and personal reflections to convey authenticity and agency (examples: "You are no longer victims. You are survivors.", direct addresses to Nassar).

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide factual legal and sentencing context
rubrics_metrics.description: After listening to their testimonies... Judge Rosemarie Aquilina sentenced Nassar to 175 years in prison... Nassar had already been sentenced to 60 years for possessing over 37,000 images of child pornography, and pleaded guilty in November to 'seven charges of first-degree sexual assault'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include concise factual context about charges, pleas, sentences, and notable courtroom rulings or judge statements to situate testimonies within the judicial outcome and timeline; quote key judicial remarks when relevant (example: "I just signed your death warrant").

rubrics_metrics.name: Use statistics to contextualize prevalence
rubrics_metrics.description: Quoting a statistic that says one in 10 children will be sexually abused before their 18th birthday; the article translates this into a national figure (400,000 babies born in the US will become victims).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Introduce reputable statistics to illustrate the scale of the issue and connect individual stories to broader societal patterns; when presenting startling figures, optionally translate rates into absolute numbers for reader impact and cite sources if available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Detail personal/background information (ages, injuries, sport affiliations)
rubrics_metrics.description: The piece repeatedly notes ages at first abuse (e.g., 12, 13, 15, 16), the injuries prompting treatment, and athletic affiliations (Olympic gymnasts, university athletes).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report survivors' ages at the time of abuse, the medical/athletic context that brought them to the abuser, and subsequent impacts on careers and education to give readers a clear sense of vulnerability, chronology, and consequences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Describe patterns of abuse and methods of manipulation
rubrics_metrics.description: The abuse appeared to follow a similar pattern: women would go to Nassar in pain with various injuries; he would abuse them with his 'special treatment', inserting his ungloved fingers into their vaginas or rectums; some were abused hundreds of times.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarise recurring patterns and manipulative tactics (e.g., positioning as a trusted doctor, explanations framing abuse as treatment) to help readers understand how abuse was enabled; balance specific descriptive detail with sensitivity and the trigger warning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Credit images and link to full statements / related resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Images: Rex Features; You can read her full statement here; mentions movements like #MeToMSU.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include image credits and links to full statements, original sources, or survivor-led movements; provide readers with ways to access fuller testimony or support resources and to verify claims.
